benchmarks.label: Q1 at 10% scale — invoice fetch cutoff: 2024-03-20T00:00:00+00:00. Naive MongoDB: full invoice scan + Python aggregation.
Q2 at 10% scale — invoice pool drawn from invoices before 2024-03-20T00:00:00+00:00. Naive: 4-query fetch pattern.
Q3 at 10% scale — row-based scaling: user pool drawn from 10% of all session users. No date cutoff applied.
Q4 at 10% scale — orders cutoff: 2024-03-20T00:00:00+00:00. Naive: two-pass aggregation over order_items.
Q5 at 10% scale — product corpus cutoff: 2024-03-20T00:00:00+00:00. Naive: $text search with created_at filter.
Q6 at 10% scale — events cutoff: 2024-03-20T00:00:00+00:00. Naive: string range scan on (user_id, occurred_at) index. Window anchored on sampled real event — guaranteed non-empty.
Q7 at 10% scale — invoice window cutoff: 2024-03-20T00:00:00+00:00. Naive: server-side $densify + $setWindowFields pipeline. $toDouble cast on total_usd (stored as string in naive schema).
